title: Choose the visual world
question: Second re-roll. Your steer is the lead: SaaS product landing + Curved Crease as the system (reading Grease as Crease). Lock it, take the roll, or re-roll.

options.label: Crease Landing
options.lineage: SaaS product landing wearing a curved-crease deployable shell
options.thesis: The page is a normal product landing whose law is one compass arc: Longest Path creases the Clearwater programme from a flat plan into a rigid shell.
options.viewport: Nav, headline, Sign in and Try now in the usual SaaS places; the product proof is a Clearwater Gantt that folds along one charcoal Longest-Path arc — not a scrapbook, not a login wall.
options.risk: Reads as architecture-school paper if the SaaS chrome fails, or as generic SaaS if the crease is only decoration.

raised.raise: Overlapping activities are named joint states (FS/SS), not color-only chords.
The fold snaps in computation steps, not a mushy ease.
Longest Path days print as computed output on the sheet, not a marketing KPI.
Prior programme issues stay reachable as opened layers, not torn collage.

options.label: Machine HMI
options.lineage: CNC mill readout and industrial cycle-start panel
options.thesis: The landing is a machine panel: Clearwater’s path as a calibrated readout, Try now as cycle-start.
options.viewport: Industrial chrome, large Longest Path 312d readout, a compact Gantt as the toolpath, Sign in and Try now as panel keys.
options.risk: Reads as factory-floor hardware, not construction CPM, if the activities fail to stay BOQ-phased.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.lineage: theater cyclorama passing from black night through cobalt and rose into day
options.thesis: CPM states are lighting cues: empty is night, calculating is first light, valid is day; the programme stands in front of the dawn.
options.viewport: Horizon bands behind a Clearwater programme; Sign in and Try now as cue keys labeled NIGHT / DAY.
options.case: Holds product clarity as empty / calculating / valid; a theater cyc does not identify a construction PM.
options.risk: Reads as a performing-arts site if the programme is not the actor.

options.label: Color Chord Canopy
options.lineage: translucent silk banners overlapping in a courtyard
options.thesis: Concurrent activities as passing color chords.
options.viewport: Silk lanes crossing a bright field, overlaps labeled as FS/SS.
options.case: A courtyard canopy does not identify a planning office, and silk reads as lifestyle craft.
options.risk: Reads as a fashion or architecture biennale.
options.kept: Overlap as a named joint state, not color alone.

options.label: Arcade Cabinet
options.viewport: Score-bar chrome, tile-grid Gantt, Try now as START.
options.case: Toy chrome is banned, and an arcade does not identify a stakeholder meeting.
options.risk: Reads as a game, not CPM software.
options.kept: Motion snaps in whole computation steps.

options.label: Midnight Terminal
options.thesis: The engine prints the path as a live transcript.
options.viewport: 80-column CPM log, Try now as a command.
options.case: Dark-neon and hacker chrome fail the meeting-screen test.
options.risk: Reads as a retro developer toy.
options.kept: Longest Path prints as computed output.

options.label: Flyer Wall
options.thesis: Programme issues stacked as torn layers.
options.viewport: A wall of sheets, the top one Clearwater.
options.case: This is the scrapbook this project already refused.
options.kept: Prior issues stay reachable as opened layers.

options.label: Memphis Showroom
options.thesis: The landing as cheerful colliding furniture.
options.viewport: Chunky blocks arguing on a speckled floor.
options.case: Toy geometry fails stakeholder trust and the anti-scrapbook brief.
options.kept: Short spring on the fold only, never pattern-as-identity.

canonCard.label: SaaS product landing
canonCard.thesis: The same landing skeleton without the crease: nav, headline, product screenshot, Sign in and Try now.
canonCard.viewport: Marketing header, hero copy left, Gantt right, three feature cards.
